headline: Microsoft previews two new ways to control Xbox Cloud Gaming
summary: Microsoft is previewing two new ways to play Xbox Cloud Gaming: a Wi-Fi connection that lets the Xbox Nano controller link directly to the cloud service, and the option to use a phone as a controller on smart TVs. Engadget notes the Wi-Fi feature echoes a trick Google Stadia used previously.
